|game_text='''Dark Side:''' May ▼ [[Superlaser]]. At 'blown away' systems, adds one [Light Side] and one [Dark Side]. Whenever you Force drain at a 'blown away' system [[Death Star]] orbits, may retrieve 1 Force.

'''Light Side:''' Opponent's Force drain bonuses at systems (except your systems) are limited to 1. Immune to [[Expand The Empire (V){{!}}Expand The Empire]].
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1. The original printed text (18 June 2010) has not been found, so it has no page yet. The images (Players Committee card image and release-sheet slip) print this text. The later errata version is [[Death Star: Central Core (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text).
* '''Original''' (first printing, Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet, 18 June 2010): text not found. The Players Committee news post of 23 July 2010 gives the errata as the new texts below; before it the card had no “Immune to Expand The Empire.” and an older Dark Side text<ref name="src-S4">Players Committee news post "Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes", 23 July 2010 (effective 26 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>. The surviving copy of the release sheet was re-made after the errata.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): errata announced 23 July 2010, effective 26 July 2010<ref name="src-S4">Players Committee news post "Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes", 23 July 2010 (effective 26 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>; the re-made Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (re-made 28 July 2010) prints it<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Dark Side: May ▼ Superlaser. At ‘blown away’ systems, adds one [Light Side] and one [Dark Side]. Whenever you Force drain at a ‘blown away’ system Death Star orbits, may retrieve 1 Force. Light Side: Opponent’s Force drain bonuses at systems (except your systems) are limited to 1. Immune to Expand The Empire.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p5-22-Death_Star_Central_Core.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-deathstarcentralcore-pre.gif]], errata mark E) print it. The PC website card list gives no text for locations.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Death Star: Central Core (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 43) prints “Immue to Expand The Empire.” (typo kept as published); the rest is unchanged<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Dark Side: May ▼ Superlaser. At ‘blown away’ systems, adds one [Light Side] and one [Dark Side]. Whenever you Force drain at a ‘blown away’ system Death Star orbits, may retrieve 1 Force. Light Side: Opponent’s Force drain bonuses at systems (except your systems) are limited to 1. Immue to Expand The Empire.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-22-front-master.png]]) prints it.
